detail_observations.label: Faction lowered
detail_observations.text: Order of the True Blood [ edit ] Description Lennea says, " Queen Ilyia has wisely chosen to forbid her citizens from speaking of the drake riders , but because we are sworn to destroy them, we must discuss them somewhat." "We aren't certain when the drake riders first took over Thelaseen , or even what their ultimate goals are. Regardless, rather than murder fellow elves , focus on slaying the breeding drakes ." "Without drakes , the Order of the True Blood becomes a manageable threat. We'll be able to deal with them if they make a move against us." [ edit ] Objectives Enter the drake roosts of the Order of the True Blood at Thelaseen , and slay broodmothers and broodlords. Return to Lennea Arrianth at the Wardship of the Sleeping Moon . Broodmothers \ (6) Broodlords \ (2) [ edit ] Upon Completion You will be given the following rewards: ? Celestine Ward faction A coin reward of 16s The Wrath of Vol Anari Retrieved from " http://wiki.silkyvenom.com/index.php/Drakes_of_the_Order_of_the_True_Blood " Category : Thestra 31-35 Quests

pages.article_html:
Drakes of the Order of the True Blood

Level 38 · Adventuring · Wardship Of The Sleeping Moon · Thestra

Enter the drake roosts of the Order of the True Blood at Thelaseen, and slay broodmothers and broodlords.

Objectives

Broodmothers Slain (0/6) Broodlords Slain (0/2)

Description

Lennea says, " Queen Ilyia has wisely chosen to forbid her citizens from speaking of the drake riders , but because we are sworn to destroy them, we must discuss them somewhat." "We aren't certain when the drake riders first took over Thelaseen , or even what their ultimate goals are. Regardless, rather than murder fellow elves , focus on slaying the breeding drakes ." "Without drakes , the Order of the True Blood becomes a manageable threat. We'll be able to deal with them if they make a move against us."

What they say

On offering it

Lennea
Queen Ilyia has wisely chosen to forbid her citizens from speaking of the drake riders , but because we are sworn to destroy them, we must discuss them somewhat. We aren't certain when the drake riders first took over Thelaseen , or even what their ultimate goals are. Regardless, rather than murder fellow elves , focus on slaying the breeding drakes . Without drakes , the Order of the True Blood becomes a manageable threat. We'll be able to deal with them if they make a move against us.
